ONE PIECE CARD GAME NIKE Collaboration Tournament
Lace up and get ready for the ONE PIECE CARD GAME × NIKE Tournament!
Bring your favorite deck and Nike sneakers to show off your style! Let's come together and make this collaboration one to remember!
Registration opens on a first-come, first-served basis at the following dates and times:
11:00 AM PST / 2:00 PM EST / 7:00 PM GMT
Participants will receive the following prizes:
ONE PIECE CARD GAME NIKE DON!! Cards
Search for a local store on BANDAI TCG+!
Players are encouraged to apply for the tournament through BANDAI TCG+ and stores are also encouraged to accept the application from players through BANDAI TCG+.
However stores manage event registrations in different ways. Please be sure to contact your local game store directly to confirm your registration and participation.
BANDAI will not be responsible for any problems that may occur between the store and the player.
For how to register on BANDAI TCG+ please check the bottom of this page.
TCG+ is a one-stop application for Bandai Card Games that includes finding a store near to you, registering for events, tournament attendance and pairings, deck building features, and statistics.
*In events, campaigns, and promotional activities organized by our company, the following information may be disclosed to third parties.
BANDAI TCG+ member number / Nickname / Ranking / Match history / Participated events / Deck registered for tournaments

*Personal information entered to apply for this event and information registered in your “BANDAI TCG+” account may be provided to our group companies and to the distributor organizing the event in which you intend to participate. Our group companies and distributors to whom we provide the information may be located in foreign countries, but we cannot specify the country in which they are located because it depends on the event in which the person intends to participate. The locations of our group companies can be found using this link.
The tournament will be held in accordance with the Official Rules on the official website.
Please read the Official Rules and Q&A carefully before participating.

*If you have any questions about the rules during a battle, or if you have any doubts about whether or not something is correct, please raise your hand immediately and ask for a decision from the "staff" and follow their ruling. Please note that correct judgments cannot be made after the battle has progressed.
*Cards that are not legitimate, such as photocopied cards, cannot be used.
*Nike footwear is not required for tournament participation.
All images, text and data on this website may not be reproduced without permission.
Please note that the images used on this website may differ from the actual product as it is still under development.
